metadata.title: Microlocal properties of Cauchy evolution under metric variations
metadata.abstract: We develop the microlocal analysis of the Cauchy evolution for wave-type equations on the infinite-dimensional space of Lorentzian metrics. We regard the Cauchy evolution operator as a distributional function of the metric, and give this notion a precise meaning through restrictions to finite-dimensional families of metrics. We study the singularities of this metric dependence. For normally hyperbolic operators on vector bundles, we determine the resulting operator-valued wavefront sets. Their parameter covectors are given by integrals of metric variations along individual null geodesics. At ultrastatic ends, metric dependence also determines the time-translation generators and their positive- and negative-energy splitting. More generally, the parameter singularities distinguish the two characteristic sheets and can be used to reconstruct the ordinary Cauchy propagation relation, which describes propagation of singularities. Consequences include smoothing under parameter averaging and polar-cone bounds associated with averaged null-positive variations, linking the result to averaged null energy conditions. The analysis also covers the Cauchy evolution of the Dirac equation.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 度量变化下Cauchy演化的微局部奇性
analysis.workSummary: 把波型方程的Cauchy演化视为Lorentz度量无限维空间上的分布型函数，经有限维度量族的限制精确定义。对向量丛上的normally hyperbolic算子确定算子值wavefront集合，其中参数余向量由沿单条零测地线的度量变分积分给出，并可由参数奇性恢复通常Cauchy传播关系。
techniques: 零测地线上的变分积分
analysis.breakthrough: 将度量依赖的奇性与传播方向、ultrastatic端正负能量分解和平均零正变分联系，亦涵盖Dirac方程。
analysis.limitations: 需区分度量参数余方向和底流形传播关系；平均零能量联系不自动成为一般能量条件定理。具体族、支撑和Cauchy结构条件须正文。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
